sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "currencies" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "precision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "initial_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_categories" ("account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("account_id", "category_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "period" TEXT NOT NULL, "reset_day" INTEGER NULL, "alert_threshold" INTEGER NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "budget_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES budgets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "spent_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "period_start" INTEGER NOT NULL, "period_end" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "destination_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "allocation" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "period" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "debts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remaining_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "destination_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "transaction_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "recurring_transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_transactions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "debt_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES debts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "category_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "allocation" TEXT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_date" INTEGER NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
